title: Topological realizations of finite posets
summary: I introduce a new class of cell complexes, called CL-complexes, that provide alternative topological realizations of finite posets. Each realization of a given poset has the same homotopy type as the order complex of that, so in some sense these spaces do not provide anything really new. Their value is that they enable short transparent proofs of standard results in poset homotopy. These include Quillen's Theorem A for finite posets, the Nerve Theorem for good covers of a topological space, and Sheehy's multicover generalization of the Nerve Theorem.
